edits.headline: Gunmen kill 27 in two mass shootings in South Africa
edits.subheadline: Police said no arrests had been made after the attacks on a bar near Johannesburg and a store near Cape Town.
editorialBody: Gunmen killed 27 people in two mass shootings in South African townships late on Saturday 26 September, BBC News and the Associated Press reported.
Police said 17 people were killed at a bar in Wedela, southwest of Johannesburg, and 10 at a store in Lwandle, near Cape Town, the AP reported. No arrests had been made.
Five days earlier, gunmen killed at least 11 people at a house party in KwaMakhutha township near Durban, the AP reported.
Hamas said Israeli actions were "paving the way for total control" over Al-Aqsa in Jerusalem, Middle East Eye reported.
Experts quoted by Fox News said a Supreme Court fight over immigration detention "could unleash dangerous criminal migrants onto US streets".
